channel.description:
Nature Communications is an open access, multidisciplinary journal dedicated to publishing high-quality research in all areas of the biological, health, physical, chemical and Earth sciences. Papers published by the journal aim to represent important advances of significance to specialists within each field.

We are committed to providing an efficient service for both authors and readers. Our team of independent editors make rapid and fair publication decisions. Prompt dissemination of accepted papers to a wide readership and beyond is achieved through a programme of continuous online publication.

item.title: [6] Fermi-level depinning achieved by high-work-function Au1-xSex alloy contacts for high-performance p-type WSe2 transistors
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Maohai Xie, Lain-Jong Li

Authors: Wanying Li, Yipu Xia, Yuanhao Kou, et al.

Score 6/10 C_MAYBE

Why: Relevant experimental 2D material contact engineering.

Tags: #2Dmaterials #WSe2 #contacts

Abstract: Nature Communications, Published online: 09 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74149-y The fabrication of p-type contacts for 2D semiconductors remains an important challenge towards the industrialization of 2D electronics. Here, the authors report a low-temperature molecular beam epitaxy contact strategy using a high-work-function Au1-xSex alloy to achieve Fermi-level depinning in monolayer WSe2 and realize high-performance 2D p-type transistors.
